Deji quful shaashadeed
PIN, qaab, eray sir ah, ama far-raad — dhammaantood way ku filan yihiin. Heer ilaalineed kasta ayaa la heli karaa marka taleefankaagu leeyahay mid ka mid ah kuwaas.
Fur dejinta qufulka shaashadda
Ama hadda samee weedh sir ah oo hoos ka muuqata — Ugu sarreeya wuxuu xidhaa Rún laftiisa, quful shaashadeed looma baahna. Afar ama shan eray oo random ah ayaa sameeya mid xoog leh.
